commands_run:
# 1. Branch checkout
cd "<OPENXVS_WORKSPACE>"
git checkout -b feat/xvs-gemini-g-b2

# 2. V1: sRGB implementation and unit tests
$env:PYTHONPATH="src"
& "<OPENXVS_WORKSPACE>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m pytest tests/xvs/test_sensor_srgb.py
git add src/xvs/sensor/__init__.py src/xvs/sensor/srgb.py tests/xvs/test_sensor_srgb.py
git commit -m "XVS WP-03 V1: sRGB EOTF/OETF exact inversion and 8-bit round trip"

# 3. V2: PSF kernel and DTFT frequency tests
& "<OPENXVS_WORKSPACE>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m pytest tests/xvs/test_sensor_psf.py
git add src/xvs/sensor/psf.py tests/xvs/test_sensor_psf.py
git commit -m "XVS WP-03 V2: PSF kernel generation, energy normalization and DTFT match"

# 4. V3: Distortion, bicubic warping and GT transforms
& "<OPENXVS_WORKSPACE>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m pytest tests/xvs/test_sensor_distortion.py
git add src/xvs/sensor/distortion.py src/xvs/sensor/gt_transform.py tests/xvs/test_sensor_distortion.py
git commit -m "XVS WP-03 V3: Brown-Conrady distortion, bicubic warping and GT transforms"

# 5. V4: Vignetting model
& "<OPENXVS_WORKSPACE>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m pytest tests/xvs/test_sensor_vignetting.py
git add src/xvs/sensor/vignetting.py tests/xvs/test_sensor_vignetting.py
git commit -m "XVS WP-03 V4: Cos4 and polynomial optical vignetting model"

# 6. V5: EMVA 1288 noise model and estimation
& "<OPENXVS_WORKSPACE>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m pytest tests/xvs/test_sensor_emva1288.py
git add src/xvs/sensor/noise.py src/xvs/sensor/emva1288.py tests/xvs/test_sensor_emva1288.py
git commit -m "XVS WP-03 V5: EMVA 1288 sensor noise model and self-consistency analysis"

# 7. V6: End-to-end chain, configs and determinism
& "<OPENXVS_WORKSPACE>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m pytest tests/xvs/test_sensor_chain.py
git add configs/xvs/sensors/ src/xvs/sensor/chain.py tests/xvs/test_sensor_chain.py
git commit -m "XVS WP-03 V6: End-to-end imaging chain, sensor configs and determinism"

# 8. V7: Real G4 validation and contact sheet generation
& "<OPENXVS_WORKSPACE>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" scripts/xvs/sensor/validate_sensor_g0.py
git add scripts/xvs/sensor/validate_sensor_g0.py
git commit -m "XVS WP-03 V7: Master sensor model validation script, G4 contact sheets and timing"

# 9. Report tables and full suite verification
& "<OPENXVS_WORKSPACE>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" scripts/xvs/sensor/report_tables_wp03.py
& "<OPENXVS_WORKSPACE>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m pytest tests/xvs/test_sensor_*.py
